info.name: Study Management — Full Lifecycle (with Auth)
info.description:
Two-service setup:
  • Auth Service  → http://localhost:8090  (AWS Cognito wrapper)
  • Study Service → http://localhost:8080  (Spring Boot app)

Phase 0 handles all auth scenarios for every role (admin, primary_investigator, co_investigator, crc, subject, cro, hospital).
Sign-in auto-captures the idToken into the `token` variable — all subsequent study requests use it automatically.

Before running:
  1. Start both services
  2. Run PHASE 0 first — Sign In sets the `token` automatically
  3. Run Steps 1–24 in order via Postman Runner

request.description: Replace username and confirmationCode with the actual values received via email/SMS after sign-up.

item.name: AUTH 04 — Sign In (all roles)
item.description: Each Sign In request auto-captures idToken into the `token` variable and accessToken into `accessToken`. All study management requests use `token` automatically.

request.description: Promote an existing user to a different role. Roles: admin, subject, primary_investigator, co_investigator, crc, cro, hospital
Uses the `accessToken` variable captured from Sign In. previousPassword must be exactly 6 digits; proposedPassword minimum 8 chars.
